user.title: Add a Smart Timer
user.description:
Create a new Smart Timer device. You can create as many as you like.
Remember: the initial countdown duration you set here is the value used whenever the timer is reset.

data_description.name: A friendly name used for the device and entity, e.g. “Pizza”.
data_description.initial_seconds: Countdown length in seconds. Max is {max}.

abort.already_configured: A Smart Timer with that name already exists.

init.title: Smart Timer sound
init.description:
Choose what plays when the timer reaches zero. Configure a media player, a sound URL, or a local file path.

When a media player fires, the integration emits the event `smart_timer_on_fire` that you can hook into with automations.
